sections.title: 2.2 Product Features
sections.text_preview: KeePass Password Safe provides the user with the following functions:

sections.title: • Database – New, Open, Close, Save, Print, Search, Import, Export

sections.title: • Change Language
sections.text_preview: At KeePass website there are available language translations that can be downloaded and applied easily.

sections.title: • Auto-Type
sections.text_preview: The user can select a sequence of keypresses that KeePass will be able to perform and send them to any window or browser.

sections.text_preview: The user can pass a file path in the command line in order for KeePass to open this file at startup.

sections.title: • Import/Export
sections.text_preview: KeePass can support importing data from CSV files, Code Wallet, Password Safe and Personal Vault.
